notes.title: ONE YEAR ANNIVERSARY
notes.content:
Wow, it's hard to believe it has been one year since Drums of War first hit digital store shelves! But it's true and to celebrate, we are offering a week long, deep discount on the game (50%) and the soundtrack (30%). So, if you've been on the fence about trying out the first Orc War Drumming VR Simulator, then here's not better time than [b]right now[/b]! 

I would like to take this opportunity to thank everyone who has supported Drums of War on its first year of existence.

Cheers ːsteamhappyː

Alan
Grind Core Games

notes.title: Double up on the Metal Mayhem in Drums of War!
notes.content:
Double up on the Metal Mayhem in Drums of War!

Not only can you crush your enemies to great thrash metal songs by [b]Warbinger[/b], [b]Wind Rose[/b], and Exmortus in the pounding [b]Wardrum Hero[/b] Mode, but we've received quite some appreciation for the thumping in-game soundtrack by [b]Gabe Castro[/b].  

In this update we present you the full [b]Gabe Castro[/b] ear splitting metal soundtrack in all its glory. Coming to you in high quality audio and delivered to you by the power of shredding axes and devious double bass drums.

You can get the soundtrack separately to head bang to it when no one is looking, play it in the background to energize your other games, or use it to appreciate your neighbours more at 1 am at volume 11, or even better: buy the [b]bundle[/b] that combines Drums of War and the Soundtrack together at an attractive price point.

[b]\m/ Get the soundtrack now! \m/[/b]

notes.title: Drums of War is rebranded!
notes.content:
We've teamed up with the folks from Indietopia Games and rebranded Drums of War. When we released the game in October, our main focus was to get the best experience out there. 

After the release we've figured that the artwork we've been using in the store does not represent the game as it should. So, the last couple of months we've been working on a new look for Drums of War and are now thrilled to show you the results. Hope you'll like it just as much as we do. We've also released a brand new trailer, which you can find on the front page of our Steam Store.

In a couple of weeks we've another exciting update coming up! Don't forget, if you have something you would like to see updated in the game, just leave it in the comment section. 

For now #stayhome and #staysafe. 

Cheers,

Grind Core Games

notes.title: Stay home and healthy update
notes.content:
Hi all,

We would like to encourage the gaming community to [b]stay home and healthy[/b], therefore we decided to push our first update earlier and discount the game for a week. 

As we are going through a weird and hard time, it's important to take care of yourself. If you are in need of a break from working, some exercise or stress relief, why not try a VR game like Drums of War? We promise you, you'll have the necessary exercise while having a lot fun! 

The stay home and healthy update includes licensed track Drunken Dwarves from [url=https://www.windroseofficial.com/]Wind Rose[/url]. Go into bonus mode and enjoy this awesome track brought to you by [url=https://www.napalmrecords.com/]Napalm Records[/url]. Here's the full list of changes: 
[*]Wind Rose "Drunken Dwarves" song added to bonus modes
[*]Adjust height added to pause menu
[*]Tutorial improvements - progress is now blocked until the stick fireball ability is executed
[*]Tutorial improvements - simplified music track when learning movement to reinforce pounding to the beat
[*]Fixed a bug with the Demon Queen's health
[/list]
We are also preparing another update which includes our new partnership with Indietopia Games and the release of the Drums of War soundtrack from the composer of indie hit 'The Forest: Gabe Castro. If you have something you would like to see (updated) in Drums of War, leave it in the comment section.

Cheers,
Grind Core Games
